issues.what: The storm masks the interior, but the exposed pedestal flips from dark moss to pale sand while the scattered petals, reflection and background lighting change with it. The exterior gives the swap away.
issues.fix: Carry the tabletop, background and contact shadow continuously through the swap, and hide the pedestal replacement at peak motion or behind a foreground veil that covers the base as well as the glass.

issues.what: Most sampled shake poses are upright lateral offsets with little vertical separation from the table. A tilt is visible near 23.33 s, but the lift and seat lack a clear weight transfer.
issues.fix: Add a resisted lift and sharper, unequal reversals with delayed tilt, then a firm heel-first contact and short damped settle. Drive the reflection and contact shadow from that same motion.

issues.where: 24.80–25.17 s, cottage, tree and flowers inside the glass
issues.what: The arrival reads mostly as an already assembled scene becoming visible as the gold veil thins, rather than the new season growing in.
issues.fix: Keep the coherent clearing whirl, but stagger a visible unfurl of leaves and flowers and a delayed ignition of the lanterns after it passes.
